We conducted a small-scale A/B test comparing outputs generated by SimMark to unwatermarked ones, using 10 randomly selected BookSum samples. Each sample pair consisted of one watermarked and one unwatermarked text. Three volunteers (all master's students in Canada, Iranian, aged between 18 and 25, with a Computer Science background) participated in the study.

Participants were asked to identify which of two outputs (watermarked vs. unwatermarked) appeared to be watermarked across 10 random samples. We also included the 'N' (no noticeable difference) option to avoid forcing a binary choice when participants genuinely could not distinguish between the texts.
